def from_ordinal(n):
    _check_int(n, 'n')
    if not (1 <= n <= 3652059):
        raise ValueError(f"ordinal {n} out of range")
    
    # Find year: binary search
    # to_ordinal(y, 1, 1) = 365*(y-1) + (y-1)//4 - (y-1)//100 + (y-1)//400 + 1
    # We want the largest y such that to_ordinal(y,1,1) <= n
    # i.e., 365*(y-1) + (y-1)//4 - (y-1)//100 + (y-1)//400 + 1 <= n
    # i.e., 365*(y-1) + (y-1)//4 - (y-1)//100 + (y-1)//400 <= n - 1
    
    t = n - 1  # 0-indexed
    
    lo, hi = 1, 9999
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi + 1) // 2
        # days from year 1 to year mid-1
        days = 365*(mid-1) + (mid-1)//4 - (mid-1)//100 + (mid-1)//400
        if days <= t:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid - 1
    y = lo
    
    # Day of year (1-indexed)
    doy = t - (365*(y-1) + (y-1)//4 - (y-1)//100 + (y-1)//400) + 1
    
    # Find month and day

        month_days[1] = 29
    
    m = 1
    while m <= 12 and doy > month_days[m-1]:
        doy -= month_days[m-1]
        m += 1
    
    return (y, m, doy)
